title: Big Feelings by Ryan Drake at The Cell #bigfeelingstheplay #immersive...
transcript: In a perfectly calibrated blend of nostalgia and discomfort, Big Feelings transports you back to age 7 for 90 immersive minutes. You participate as a first grade pupil to Ms. Joy, played by Julia Greer — her performance is remarkably grounded and convincing, it's almost uncanny. As far as getting you into the world of the piece, the level of commitment is pretty astounding. Aside from just the classroom decor, the agenda is packed and interactive, including morning work, group activities, and even a snack break. Over time, the class materials reveal some less lighthearted themes, and let's just say the day unravels from there. A satisfying and deeply original piece about the ways we mask at work and how our childhood core memories inform our adult selves, Big Feelings is running at The Cell on 23rd through the 23rd.
